As far as we know, dear Matrim, the Myrddraal are Trolloc by-products who have nearly returned to their human original genetic code, if such a thing were possible. We know far too little on the subject of trolloc genetics, if anyone asks for my opinion. Personally I could accept the vision that the Myrddraal is "born" fully grown, and that the female does not survive the event. What's the matter on trollocs anyway? Are they born as babies? How come they survive until adulthood? Or are they also, many of them, born fully or well grown? If so, the female Trolloc must be several times more common than the male one that is faced in battle. You see, the questions are endless. I'm not that fascinated directly by the trolloc off-spring - after all, I am no Brown - but I do think Aginor could have left us a reserach manual or two. As I said, I'm prepared to buy the explanation that Myrddraal are born fully grown.
